name: LEHMAN BROTHERS UK CAPITAL FUNDING II LP

announcements.headline: EQS-News: Notice of Interim Payment
announcements.insight: Lehman Brothers UK Capital Funding II LP confirms an interim payment following its August notice. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for final distribution details.

announcements.headline: Notice of Interim Payment
announcements.insight: Lehman Brothers UK Capital Funding II LP proceeds with an interim payment following the August proposal. Shareholders should monitor for further distribution details or final settlement terms.

announcements.headline: Notice of Proposed Interim Payment
announcements.insight: Lehman Brothers UK Capital Funding II LP proposes an interim payment, indicating insolvency proceedings. This suggests significant financial distress and potential loss for shareholders.
